6368968.name: Chabad of Greenlawn & Centerport
6368968.note: CrownHeights.info, 4 Dec 2024, on seed funding for 'one hundred new Chabad centers in underserved areas', shows 'Rabbi Shmuli and Rivka Laufer at Chabad of Greenlawn & Centerport, NY'. Its chabad.org listing went up 17 Apr 2024.

6672961.name: Chabad of Jackson Heights
6672961.note: CrownHeights.info, 9 Apr 2025 ('35 New Shluchim Receive Grants'): 'Rabbi Meir & Mrs. Chani Pape - Chabad of Jackson Heights, Jackson Heights, New York'. Its chabad.org listing went up 9 Dec 2024. Medium: new-shluchim grants in April 2025 for a listing made in Dec 2024; when they began is not stated.

5805649.name: Chabad of Hewlett Neck & Old Woodmere
5805649.note: Chabad.org on CrownHeights.info, 21 Sept 2023: Chabad of Sea Cliff and Glen Cove 'is the second Chabad House to open on Long Island this year, joining the Chabad of Hewlett Neck and Old Woodmere, which is run by Rabbi Mendel and Goldie Gordon.' Medium: the IRS recognized 'Chabad Of Hewlett Neck And Old Woodmere Inc' from Nov 2022 and its chabad.org listing went up in 2022, a year before.
